name: Flask of the North: custom classes keep the server alive and receive a flask
contract: Flask of the North (item 47499) casts 67019, whose DBC tooltip grants spell power 67016 (47),
attack power 67017 (80) or Strength 67018 (40) for one hour. Item 47499 requires Alchemy 400,
so the fixture learns and casts 67019 directly; the item only supplies that spell.
Stock selection by class: Mage receives only spell power, Warrior only Strength.
Custom classes 12-32 previously built an empty choice list and irand(0, -1) aborted the worldserver.
Pyromancer is a spell-power caster and must receive only the spell power flask.
Barbarian is a physical class: never spell power. Documented decision without live evidence:
custom classes choose through their existing legacy class, so Barbarian (Rogue) receives attack power.
A clean run end with every actor alive proves the server survived; flask amounts are not measured.
